{: .no_toc }

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rows | list | Session: user_agent, ip_address, amr, created_at, last_seen_at, expires_at | staff see full IP | GtkListBox .boxed-list |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Revoke | `DELETE /users/{id}/sessions/{sessionId}` |  |
| Sign out everywhere | `POST /users/{id}/sessions/revoke-all` | Confirm (COPY "Sign out everywhere (staff)"). 200 `{revoked}` → toast; the list empties. Their account stays active. |
